name: sql-format-vscode
description: Format T-SQL using sql-format with RedGate-compatible JSON style configs

sqlFormat.styleFile.markdownDescription: Path to a JSON style configuration file (RedGate-compatible). Relative paths resolve against the document's workspace folder. Leave empty to use defaults or auto-detection.

sqlFormat.autoDetectStyleFile.markdownDescription: When `#sqlFormat.styleFile#` is not set, look for a `.sqlformat.json` file in the workspace root and use it if present.
